Code blocks use tilde fences

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<pre><code>let x = 1;</code></pre>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(code_block_style: 'Tildes'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
